sections.heading: Your Vision, Our Expertise

items.v:
At OPTIMAX EYE SPECIALIST, we believe that clear vision should be achieved with confidence, comfort, and the highest level of care. As pioneers in refractive eye surgery in Malaysia, we proudly offer the latest advancement in laser vision correction — ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0.
This cutting-edge procedure is designed to reduce your reliance on glasses or contact lenses using minimally invasive technology trusted by eye surgeons worldwide. Our commitment to clinical excellence, patient safety, and technological leadership has made us a preferred name in vision correction.

sections.image_alt: Patient undergoing ZEISS SMILE PRO laser eye surgery at OPTIMAX Eye Specialist – advanced vision correction with trusted ZEISS technology in Malaysia

items.v:
ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0 – powered by ZEISS VISULYZE is the next-generation laser eye surgery that gently reshapes the cornea to correct refractive errors such as short-sightedness (myopia) and astigmatism.
Harnessing 13 years of SMILE (Small Incision Lenticule Extraction) experience and extensive treatment data, VISULYZE enables our surgeons to analyse treatment outcomes and personalise treatment planning — supporting greater precision for your vision correction journey.
Unlike traditional LASIK, ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0 does not require a corneal flap — making it a gentler, faster, and more comfortable vision correction option for eligible candidates.

v: Fast, accurate laser time — just 10 seconds

items.v: *Note: Suitability for ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0 can only be determined through a thorough clinical consultation by our certified eye specialists.

yes.heading: Who Can Benefit from ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0?

items.v: ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0 may be suitable for individuals who:

v: Lead active lifestyles or are involved in sports
Seek a minimally invasive, flapless LASIK alternative
Desire faster recovery and lower risk of dry eyes

items.v: A comprehensive consultation is needed to determine candidacy.

no.heading: Who Is Not Suitable for ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0?

items.v: While ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0 offers numerous benefits, it may not be suitable for individuals who:

v: Are diagnosed with keratoconus or irregular corneal conditions
Have uncontrolled diabetes or autoimmune conditions
Have thin corneas or severe dry eyes

items.v: Other advanced options may be recommended by your specialist.

sections.heading: ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0 Procedure Steps
intro: How ZEISS SMILE® PRO 3.0 Works — Step by Step:

items.title: Eye Preparation
items.text: Numbing drops are applied; no general anesthesia is needed.

items.title: Laser Application
items.text: The ZEISS VisuMax® 800 laser creates a lenticule (a thin disc-shaped piece of tissue) and a small incision.

items.title: Lenticule Removal
items.text: Through the micro-incision, the lenticule is gently removed, reshaping the cornea.

items.title: Healing Begins
items.text: No stitches are required, and the incision heals naturally.

note: Total laser time is approximately 8-10 seconds per eye.
